environment.topology: single-host laboratory (docker compose); primary and recovery databases are containers on one machine
environment.disclaimer: Demonstrates the recovery procedure. NOT geographic disaster recovery and NOT evidence of production recovery times.

objectives.note: Targets for recovery from backup alone (no standby): restore within 4 h; loss bounded by the backup interval.

summary: Backup backup-20261113T073629Z restored into an isolated instance and verified in 13.8 s. Recovery point is the start of the backup, 18.5 s before the simulated disaster; the 1 transaction written after the backup was lost, as expected for backup-only recovery.

steps.name: Create one transaction AFTER the backup (expected to be lost)
Start an isolated, empty recovery instance
steps.detail: roles and empty databases present, no tables

steps.name: Restore every database from the backup
Verify restored row counts
steps.detail: 15 tables within the bounds recorded at backup time

steps.name: Verify recorded transactions in the restored databases
steps.detail: cases, decisions, pending task, asset, audit records, identity store and RLS present

steps.name: Detect lost transactions
steps.detail: 1 transaction created after the backup is absent, as expected (APP-2026-000031)

steps.name: Run application operations against the restored database
steps.detail: read restored case, created APP-2026-000031, tenant isolation holds

steps.name: Confirm the primary was not affected
steps.detail: the live platform still has every transaction

timing.explanation: Observed RTO = from the start of the restore to a verified application on the restored database. Observed RPO = time between the START of the backup and the simulated disaster: the worst-case window of writes lost when recovering from this backup alone. In operation this window is the backup interval.

limitations: Single host, small synthetic dataset: restore time grows with data volume and is not representative of production.
The restore target is a container with disposable storage on the same machine as the primary.
Logical backup only. Point-in-time recovery from the WAL archive is configured (archive_mode=on) but was not exercised by this drill.
Only case-service was started against the restored data; the other services were verified at database level.
Object storage, event stream contents and the analytical lake are not part of this backup (see the DR architecture document).
